sentences.en: Many migratory birds come to this pond every year in winter.
sentences.zh: 许多迁徙的鸟儿每年冬天都会飞到这个池塘来。

sentences.en: The swift is a small migratory bird of the family Apodidae.
sentences.zh: 燕子是一种小型的迁徙鸟类，属于雨燕科。

sentences.en: The swallows are migratory birds which arrive in autumn.
sentences.zh: 燕子是迁徙的鸟类，秋天就会到来。

senses.zh: 迁移的,有迁居习惯（或特色）的,流浪的,<医>游走性的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：migr（移动）+atory（有…性质的）→迁徙的
